description: This file defines a React functional component named LoggingSettings, which provides an interface for configuring logging callbacks and disabled callbacks for a team or application. It includes UI elements for adding, removing, and editing logging configurations, as well as selecting callbacks to disable, with support for dynamic parameters related to specific callbacks.

methods.name: LoggingSettings
methods.description: React functional component for configuring logging callbacks and disabled callbacks, supporting dynamic parameters and UI interactions.
